verdict.rationale: Linear's built-in agent does produce AI-generated output from workspace data. Write with Agent reviews changes since the last update and Slack messages, then drafts a project update. Customer feedback is turned into issues that are automatically labeled and prioritized, Guided Reviews explain what changed and why, and Loops explain plan changes. What is not evidenced is a dedicated insights or analytics experience that surfaces recommendations across the user's data, and all of this rests on vendor changelog claims. missing for 10: a dedicated in-product AI insights/analytics or recommendation surface over workspace data, natural-language Q&A over data, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: The agent reviews changes made since the last update, checks messages in the linked Slack channel, and writes an update draft for you to refine.
Automatically turn conversations and customer feedback into actionable issues that are instantly routed, labeled, and prioritized for the right team.
Guided Reviews break diffs into focused sections with explainers on what changed and why.
When a project's target date changes, a loop can automatically update the launch plan and post a Slack message explaining what changed, why, and who needs to act.
